scripts.build: esbuild src/daemon.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --minify --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" --external:bufferutil --external:utf-8-validate --define:process.env.WS_NO_BUFFER_UTIL="'1'" --define:process.env.WS_NO_UTF_8_VALIDATE="'1'" --log-level=warning
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
